kubectl_manifest.cluster_pca_issuer creates an AWSPCAClusterIssuer custom resource, but it only depends on aws_acmpca_certificate_authority.example and the cluster id. The `awspca.cert-manager.io` CRD is installed by the aws-privateca-issuer add-on deployed by module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons (enable_aws_privateca_issuer = true). Without an ordering dependency on that module, Terraform may try to apply the CR before the CRD exists, causing the apply to fail. The sibling kubectl_manifest.example_pca_certificate already depends on this module.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng lists aws_iam_role.managed_ng in depends_on, but it already references aws_iam_role.managed_ng[0].arn in its node_role_arn argument, which establishes the same implicit dependency. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.update_trust_policy lists kubernetes_namespace.spark in depends_on, but its local-exec command already references kubernetes_namespace.spark.id, which establishes the implicit dependency. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.update_trust_policy lists aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution in depends_on, but its local-exec command already references aws_iam_role.emr_on_eks_execution.id, which establishes the implicit dependency. The explicit depends_on entry is redundant.
